gate.bass.label: Bass Gate
gate.bass.openingLine: The Bloom-Bass swells the room. The Hollow-Step steals the floor.
gate.mid.label: Mid Gate
gate.mid.openingLine: The Echo-Shell scoops the center away. The Cup-Horn pushes color through the middle.
gate.treble.label: Treble Gate
gate.treble.openingLine: The Spark-Flicker lights the top. The Veil-Moth dims it.
gate.spatial.position.label: Position Gate

gate.spatial.image.label: Image Gate

gate.dynamic.snapback.label: Snapback Gate

gate.dynamic-snapback.openingLine: The Clean-Reset returns before the next hit. The Drag-Tail arrives late.
gate.dynamic.pressureflow.label: Pressureflow Gate
gate.dynamic-pressureflow.openingLine: The Pressure-Bloom holds the wave together. The Ceiling-Spark breaks when the peaks climb too high.
gate.integrity.contamination.label: Contamination Gate
gate.integrity-contamination.openingLine: The Veil-Mist rides behind the song. The Ground-Drone fixes itself under it.
gate.integrity.glitch.label: Glitch Gate
gate.integrity.glitch.summary: Clicks, pops, crackles, dropouts, and squeaks
gate.integrity-glitch.openingLine: The Snap-Bead strikes and vanishes. The Missing-Ribbon steals a piece of time.

giftPair.bass.explanation: Start by hearing low-end bloom against missing weight: Boomy fills the bass body while Thin removes the foundation.
giftPair.mid.explanation: Use this pair to hear an empty center against projected midrange color before judging warmth, boxiness, nasal tone, and shout.
giftPair.treble.explanation: This pair teaches top-end light against top-end loss, so edge and air do not blur together later.
giftPair.spatial-position.explanation: Begin with placement. The first pair should make left and right obvious before center, near, or far are judged.
giftPair.spatial-image.explanation: Use this pair to hear whether a source has a clean outline or a smeared image before judging width and room.
giftPair.dynamic-snapback.explanation: This pair is about recovery timing: Tight resets in time, Loose leaves a tail into the next hit.
giftPair.dynamic-pressureflow.explanatio: Use this pair to separate controlled pressure from moving pressure: Compressed holds peaks, Pumping audibly ducks and returns.
giftPair.integrity-contamination.explana: Start with steady contamination: Hiss is broadband air, Hum is a fixed tonal intruder.
giftPair.integrity-glitch.explanation: Start with timeline faults: Click adds a tiny event, Dropout removes a tiny piece of the music.

orientation.pathBody: Learn the anchors, collect the Atlas discoveries, connect real-world words, then enter the Tower.
orientation.pathSectionBody: Complete these places in order to unlock the Calibration Tower.
orientation.purposeBody: Train a reliable listening vocabulary for sound changes.
orientation.methodBody: Hear an effect, identify its anchor card, then test combinations.
orientation.outcomeBody: Use the same words consistently across training, collection, and lab work.
orientation.whyBody: Descriptor Cards trains a shared listening vocabulary: hear a change, name a stable anchor, then combine anchors into discoveries you can test on music.
orientation.loopBody: Train the anchor, find its place on the Atlas, learn how people talk about it, then experiment with the sound yourself.

hint.powerful: Find the sound that shakes the floor with a clear hit.
hint.impactful: Find a low hit with a sharper punch.
hint.shimmering: Find the top-end shine that floats above the mix.
hint.full: Find body that still keeps the top open.
hint.thick: Find warmth with extra low-end mass.
hint.vivid: Find low-end bloom with bright top clarity.
hint.bloated: Find low bloom plus upper-bass cloud.
hint.muffled: Find clouded lows with detail pulled back.
hint.chesty: Find warm body with an enclosed chest tone.
hint.pinched: Find the squeezed nasal mid color.
hint.brassy: Find a squawky, brass-like bite on a forward tone.
hint.reedy: Find a small boxed tube tone with a dry hard edge.
hint.cloudy: Find low-mid fog inside a box.
hint.woolly: Find heavy lows with weak detail.
hint.veiled: Find clarity hidden behind low-mid cover.
hint.energetic: Add bright spark to the bass force.
hint.congested: Find several masking regions crowding the middle.
hint.exciting: Push the force upward until it opens into air.
hint.buried: Find the whole sound covered under lows and mids.
hint.tinny: Find missing body with a hard upper edge.
hint.spitty: Find thin consonants that jump forward.
hint.metallic: Find hard edge with glassy treble that rings like metal.
hint.aggressive: Find forward presence with a harsh edge.
hint.sharp: Find bright detail with a harder outline.
hint.crisp: Find shiny top detail with a glassy snap.
hint.scooped: Find the center carved out while the top stays airy.
hint.distant: Find the sound stepping back with less detail.
hint.lean: Find missing foundation with an exposed clear top.
hint.empty: Find the floor and center both scooped away.
hint.faded: Find body and sparkle both worn down.
hint.brittle: Find thin, bright sound that feels fragile.
hint.cold: Find missing warmth with exposed pale air.
hint.fatiguing: Find forward edge that becomes tiring.
hint.plasticky: Find thin hollow artificial tone with a glassy surface edge.
hint.piercing: Find the stacked edge that feels needle-bright.
hint.precise: Find the source that locks clearly in the center.
hint.diffuse: Find the image that spreads out but loses a clear outline.
hint.intimate: Find the sound that feels close and dry.
hint.set_back: Find the sound that moves farther away with room around it.
hint.spacious: Find the field that opens wider with more room around it.
hint.sluggish: Find the hit that feels rounded and slow to recover.
hint.overdriven: Find the peaks pushed past clean headroom.
card.rumble.label: Rumble
card.rumble.summary: Deep sub-bass movement felt more than heard.
card.thump.label: Thump
card.thump.summary: Short low-bass impact and physical hit.
card.boomy.label: Boomy
card.boomy.summary: Broad low-end bloom and lingering bass.
card.punchy.label: Punchy
card.punchy.summary: Focused bass hit with more attack than bloom.
card.thin.label: Thin
card.muddy.label: Muddy
card.warm.label: Warm
card.warm.summary: Broad low-mid body without obvious boxiness.
card.boxy.label: Boxy
card.boxy.summary: Narrow low-mid enclosure or cardboard resonance.
card.hollow.label: Hollow
card.hollow.summary: Scooped body that makes the center feel empty.
card.honky.label: Honky
card.nasal.label: Nasal
card.nasal.summary: Forward nose-like resonance in voices and leads.
card.shouty.label: Shouty
card.shouty.summary: Aggressive presence that makes vocals push forward.
card.harsh.label: Harsh
card.harsh.summary: Upper-mid and lower-treble edge that causes fatigue.
card.dull.label: Dull
card.dull.summary: Broad loss of detail and openness.
card.sibilant.label: Sibilant
card.sibilant.summary: Consonants and cymbal edges jump forward.
card.glassy.label: Glassy
card.glassy.summary: Hard smooth treble sheen with a reflective edge.
card.bright.label: Bright
card.airy.label: Airy
card.airy.summary: High-treble extension and open air above the mix.
card.left.label: Left
card.left.summary: The sound image moves toward the left side.
card.right.label: Right
card.right.summary: The sound image moves toward the right side.
card.centered.label: Centered
card.centered.summary: The sound sits in the middle between left and right.
card.focused.label: Focused
card.focused.summary: The source has a stable, easy-to-locate outline.
card.blurred.label: Blurred
card.blurred.summary: The source spreads or smears instead of staying point-like.
card.wide.label: Wide
card.wide.summary: The stereo field stretches outward toward the sides.
card.narrow.label: Narrow
card.narrow.summary: The stereo field shrinks inward toward the center.
card.near.label: Near
card.near.summary: The sound feels closer and more direct.
card.far.label: Far
card.far.summary: The sound feels set back with less direct presence.
card.dry.label: Dry
card.dry.summary: The sound has little room reflection around it.
card.reverberant.label: Reverberant
card.reverberant.summary: The sound carries extra room reflections.
card.separated.label: Separated
card.separated.summary: Parts feel easier to place apart in the stereo scene.
card.crowded.label: Crowded
card.crowded.summary: Parts feel bunched together or spatially overlapped.
card.snappy.label: Snappy
card.snappy.summary: Fast hit starts remain clean and decisive.
card.softened.label: Softened
card.softened.summary: Hit starts feel rounded and less decisive.
card.tight.label: Tight
card.tight.summary: The sound resets cleanly before the next hit.
card.loose.label: Loose
card.loose.summary: Recovery drags or smears between hits.
card.compressed.label: Compressed
card.compressed.summary: The sound is level-controlled and less free-moving.
card.squashed.label: Squashed
card.squashed.summary: The sound is heavily pressed and flattened.
card.pumping.label: Pumping
card.pumping.summary: The level ducks and returns in audible waves.
card.breathing.label: Breathing
card.breathing.summary: The level swells and relaxes more slowly.
card.flat-dynamics.label: Flat
card.flat-dynamics.summary: The performance loses expressive level motion.
card.clipped.label: Clipped
card.clipped.summary: Loud peaks hit a hard ceiling and lose shape.
card.distorted.label: Distorted
card.distorted.summary: Loud moments gain roughness that follows the signal.
card.hiss.label: Hiss
card.hiss.summary: A steady high-frequency noise floor sits behind the music.
card.static.label: Static
card.static.summary: Rough fuzzy contamination rides behind the music.
card.hum.label: Hum
card.hum.summary: A low electrical tone appears under the music.
card.buzz.label: Buzz
card.buzz.summary: A rough harmonic electrical tone rides under the sound.
card.whine.label: Whine
card.whine.summary: A thin high-pitched tone intrudes over the music.
card.dirty.label: Dirty
card.dirty.summary: The playback feels contaminated, rough, or unclean.
card.click.label: Click
card.click.summary: A small sharp tick appears during playback.
card.pop.label: Pop
card.pop.summary: A larger sudden impulse bursts into the playback.
card.crackle.label: Crackle
card.crackle.summary: Clusters of tiny ticks flicker through the audio.
card.dropout.label: Dropout
card.dropout.summary: The music briefly drops away and returns.
card.squeak.label: Squeak
card.squeak.summary: A short high friction chirp appears as a fault event.
